title: WorkflowMeta
description:
Represents the metadata for a workflow (workflow.toml).
Contains workflow-level configuration including global parameters and job dependencies.

dependencies.description:
Job dependencies mapping: job_name -> list of jobs it depends on.
Example: { "job_2": ["job_1"], "job_3": ["job_1", "job_2"] }

env_passthrough.description: Host environment variable names to forward into the container exec environment.

params.description: Global parameter definitions for this workflow.

schema_version.description: Format version this workflow is written against; absent means 1.0.

ParamDefinition.description: Represents a parameter definition in job.toml.

default.description: Any TOML value here; `silva validate` checks it against `type`.

ParamType.description: Represents the type of a parameter.
